name: Rat
description: You see three huge rats charging at you! One is black, one is brown, and one is tan. Each one has sharp white teeth.
death_message: The rats shriek and go limp.

name: Priest
description: There is a huge man in religious garb with an insane look on his face here. In his right hand, he carries a mace.
death_message: The Priest falls to the ground with a final curse.
dialogue: You dare profane this holy place?!

name: Cynthia
description: You see a beautiful girl in a flowing white dress. You recognize her as Cynthia Luxom, Duke Luxom's not-too-bright daughter.

name: Hermit
description: There is a grizzled old hermit (who smells as if he hasn't taken a bath in forty years) in the room.

name: Gorilla
description: There is a huge, hairy, strong and angry gorilla in the room with you!
death_message: The gorilla falls with a mighty crash.

name: Heinrich
description: A human warrior stands before you, armed with a longsword and carrying a shield. On his shield is a sticker which says, "Hi, I'm Heinrich!"
dialogue: Stand and fight like a warrior!

name: Mimic
description: A chest-shaped monster is in the room, holding you with two tentacles and attempting to disassemble you with a third one.
death_message: The Mimic collapses into a formless blob.

name: Pirate
description: You see a man with a beard and a brass ring in his ear. He is wearing clothes made out of silk and is wielding a very fancily engraved sword.
death_message: The Pirate falls, his sword clattering to the ground.
